title: Theoretical analysis of the effect of the kinetic energy operator on double heterostructure spectra
summary: We report an analytical and numerical study of the effect of kinetic energy operator (KEO) ambiguity on the energy spectra of double heterostructures when the mass of the charge carriers, subjected to a potential, depends on position. The spectra are calculated using two complementary techniques. In the first case, which is not always possible, the energy spectrum satisfies a transcendental equation, which is obtained through an analytical process.
